title: tetrataenium ceylanicum
intro: Tetrataenium ceylanicum, commonly known as Wild Cumin, is a plant species that belongs to the Apiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including the ability to reduce fever and alleviate gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Tetrataenium ceylanicum include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of the plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
